title: A One-Third Bound for the Maker--Breaker Degree Game
summary: Let \(H\) be a finite hypergraph with rank $r$ and minimum degree \(d\). In the Maker--Breaker degree game, Maker and Breaker alternately claim previously unclaimed hyperedges of \(H\), with Maker moving first, and Breaker seeks to maximize the minimum degree $δ(H_{\mathrm B})$ of his spanning subhypergraph $H_{\mathrm B}$.
